completeness: 0 through final frame, 57 audio ended events in expected order, loop disabled, rate 1, no operator seek, no audio load failure
captionDiagnostic: Capture each timeline clause boundary and nominal 100ms samples. Compare actual DOM caption to frame-expected caption and audio-time-expected caption. Retain all differences; a boundary mismatch cluster spanning at least 250ms is a diagnostic concern, shorter differences are reported separately.
eventDiagnostic: Record media events before playback, including seeking, seeked, waiting, stalled, ratechange and ended. Distinguish zero-time initialization from in-clip correction. No hidden exclusions.
reproduction: Observe the full upper episode once at original rate. Never infer absence of an intermittent problem from one non-reproducing run.
